observations: Two photos show the interior of a shipping container packed with multiple stacked used engines on wooden shelving.
A man in a red shirt and cap stands on a rusty flatbed truck, leaning into the container to inspect/mark an engine.
No individual engine is isolated or photographed close-up; no engine code, serial tag, or compression/running test is visible.
No odometer, VIN tag, or part-number sticker is legible on any single unit.
This appears to be a bulk wholesale lot of imported used engines, not a single itemized product.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the specific engine's ID/code plate being offered
Video of that engine running or a compression test result

response.reason: The photos show an undifferentiated bulk container of used engines with no readable code, tag, or isolation of a specific unit, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to a single identifiable item or confirmed fitment.
